acceptance.assertion: The evidence records the exact Commonworld commit and deployed release together with the physical iPad model, iPadOS version, Safari version, power mode, viewport orientation and accessibility motion setting; simulated Chromium tablet profiles are not accepted as physical-device proof.

Physical Safari measurements cover idle ring motion, map pan and zoom, focus or touch pause, digital hierarchy entry and return, portrait and landscape orientation, and reduced-motion mode with repeatable frame-cadence or long-frame observations and no hidden independent animation on subordinate rings.

A documented threshold converts the measurements into one of two explicit outcomes: retain the current maximum of four subordinate lines and one text lane per bundle, or reduce detail on affected devices; visual preference alone is not treated as a performance breach.

If a threshold is breached, the remediation preserves one animated group and at most one moving textPath per bundle, introduces no per-letter DOM, keeps hierarchy semantics and accessibility summaries intact, and regenerates all version-bound public and release surfaces.

The exact evidence or remediation head passes focused ring-bundle tests, full repository validation, browser smoke, diff-bound self-review and required GitHub checks; any deployment claim is followed by exact-SHA Pages and production readback.

approval.note: Profiling is read-only until evidence shows a threshold breach; any corrective code change requires an isolated worktree, exact release binding and full Commonworld validation.

goal: Verify the adaptive digital-sphere ring bundles on a physical iPad in Safari against an exact deployed Commonworld release, measure frame cadence and compositing during idle rotation, map interaction and hierarchy transitions, and either confirm the current responsive budgets or implement a smaller fail-safe detail level without adding independently animated child rings.

does_not_establish: that Chromium iPad viewport smoke is equivalent to physical Safari GPU or compositor evidence
permission to change the current ring-bundle PR without a measured threshold breach
permission to create independently animated subordinate ring text
automatic merge, deployment or production verification authority

rollback.strategy: If a corrective detail policy regresses hierarchy, accessibility or layout, revert the device-specific policy and regenerated release artifacts together while retaining the physical-device evidence and threshold decision for a revised implementation.

title: Profile adaptive ring bundles on physical iPad Safari
